notes.title: Upcoming updates for my games – overview post
notes.content:
Hello,

https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/35149563/1f27b730eff5ca3cba12ab760456f0ba03945bef.jpg

I wanted to share some info about current and upcoming updates. This is a summary post – just find the game you’re interested in. I’m working on all of these titles solo, without a publisher or PR support, so communication isn’t perfect and updates can take time (I also have a full-time job, and game development is still a hobby for now). Always check the demo before buying. Right now, the only game without a demo is Moving Letters (it’s not finished yet). If a game doesn’t work or has issues, don’t hesitate to use Steam’s refund option. If there is no information about the game, it means it is not released and is still being worked on.

Game-by-game update list:
HorrorCore
Minor fixes. A sequel is planned where you play a detective investigating a mysterious painting.

Airhack
???

Rap Simulator
More info: https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1099510/view/536604072953776663

The Liminal Dimension
Performance improvements. Continuation is planned (hinted at in the post-credits scene).

Whispering Lane
Fixes to the Last Hope mode. Continuation also planned (post-credits intro).

Another Hardest Game
Minor bug fixes.

Apartament 1406
Bug fixes, Improvements to Last Hope mode. The story is planned to continue in a two-part structure.

Resoraki
Fixes, a new night track, and some community suggestions added.
Multiplayer is under consideration – either as an update or as Resoraki 2.

OutWave
Minor fixes and implementation of player feedback.

CATAIRE
No CATAIRE 2 planned, but a big update is coming: UNDO and RESET buttons, HD visuals, and online scoreboards.

A Last Will and Testament
Minor fixes. Possible continuation.

Hovercars 3077
New tracks, cars, online rankings, and UI improvements (incl. ultrawide 21:9 support).

MUMBA IV
Already received a recent update. Possible continuation (next adventure trip).

Shop Tycoon: Prepare Your wallet
I'm currently working on Shop Tycoon 2: Revenge of the Bandytko Gang.
Once that’s finished, I might port Shop Tycoon 1 to the new engine with HD visuals (I’ll ask for community feedback first).

ASMR LIGHTness
Minor fixes and HD update.

Bro, Where Is My Head???
Minor fixes, maybe online rankings.
Also in the works: a long-awaited sequel – Bro, That’s Not My Head!

Moving Letters
Already updated (server issues fixed). Demo will be added later. Possible HD updated or continuation.

THE IMPOSSIBLE
Free DLC is planned, maybe a HD update and a sequel: THE IMPOSSIBLE 2: New Pat(c)h

Play With Me
I’m moving PWM 1 (Remake) to the engine for PWM 2. After that, Play With Me 2 will be released – and possibly future entries (Play With M3, Play With Me 4, etc.).

notes.title: New update - version v1.4.8
notes.content:
Update v1.4.8 – Details

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45416851/ed11d06ea9e86a590aed8d196165cf2757682298.gif

Localization Fix Arabic Translation Update: This update includes a translation fix, with a focus on the Arabic language. The translation has been optimized to better fit the nuances of the language. Other localization updates have also been made to improve the overall translation quality in the game. This will provide players from different regions with a better experience in their native language.

Change on Level 5 "Last Point": An important change has been made to the lighting mechanics on level 5. Once the "last point" in this stage is reached, the sound will be turned off.

Water Running Optimization Running Speed in Water Improved: Based on player feedback, the running speed in water has been increased. This change makes moving through water environments smoother and more natural. The goal of this adjustment is to improve gameplay dynamics, making movement in these areas easier and more comfortable, thus enhancing the overall game speed.

Change in Photo Distance at the Museum Adjusted Photo Distance: The photo-taking mechanics in the museum have been changed in this version, introducing a new optimized distance from which photos can be taken. This change provides better control over interaction with the environment, allowing the player to capture images more easily. The goal is to improve immersion and dynamics in this stage.

User Interface Fixes Main Menu Button Fix: The "MAIN MENU" button functionality has been improved in both the full version of the game and the demo. This change makes transitions between the main menu and the individual levels smoother and more stable. Navigation has been improved to give players easier access to all game options.

Gamepad Support Update Optimized Gamepad Support: Gamepad support has been optimized, improving the comfort of playing with these devices. The game is now more responsive, providing better precision when using a controller, making interactions with the game smoother and more natural.

Platform Updates Support for Various Operating Systems: This update includes fixes for Windows (32/64 bit), Linux (64 bit), and Mac (64 bit) versions. The game has been optimized for these platforms, improving stability and performance across different systems. Players can now enjoy a smoother gameplay experience on various devices and hardware configurations.

Demo Version Update Demo (Windows 32/64 bit, Linux 64 bit, Mac 64 bit): A number of fixes have been made to the demo version to improve stability on different platforms. It has also been updated with changes from the full version of the game, allowing players to test the latest improvements and optimizations that enhance the overall gameplay experience.

Minor Fixes and Optimizations Minor Fixes: This update also includes smaller fixes to improve the stability and performance of the game. These changes address issues reported by players and ensure a smoother gameplay experience across various devices.

notes.title: The new update is now available: 1.3.7 (new options, creature, etc.).
notes.content:
Hello,  

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45416851/538e264b4ba66a7654d54b4d3f92b6886f0fbd79.png  
This time, I focused on improving gameplay, technical fixes, new content, and enhanced sound and visual effects.  

Gameplay Improvements & New Features  
Faster movement in water  
If you're in the water and press "SHIFT" (default), your character will move slightly faster. This subtle yet significant change allows for better control in claustrophobic, flooded corridors and increases your chances of escaping danger.  

Option to disable the VHS effect  
Not every player enjoys film grain and VHS-style post-processing. I have added an option to disable this effect in the settings, so you can adjust the game’s visuals to your preference.  

Level Changes & Enhancements  
Level 1 (Museum) – Trap after the first photo  
After taking the first photo, you will trigger a trap—forcing you to act quickly and carefully from that moment on. This adds extra tension and makes every camera click a potentially fatal decision.  

Level 3 – New creature & atmospheric upgrades  
[olist]  
 A new, previously unknown monster has been added, increasing the element of surprise.  
 Visual and audio changes intensify the tension on this level.  
 New lighting effects, improved shadows, and enhanced audio immersion make every second in this location unsettling.  
[/olist]  

Technical Updates & Optimization  

Full support for multiple platforms  
The update is available for all system versions: Windows 64-bit, Windows 32-bit, Linux 64-bit, and Mac 64-bit. This means the improved version of the game now runs more smoothly and stably on every platform.  

Linux optimization  
I have implemented compatibility fixes for Linux users, removing issues that could cause instability and improving performance on this platform.  

Bug fixes & improvements from the previous update  
Several graphical issues from the last version have been fixed. Additionally, minor animation and interaction bugs have been resolved, ensuring a better overall experience.  

Localization – Major Language Update  
[olist]  
 A thorough update of all supported language translations. Many errors have been fixed, missing phrases added, and the translations refined to better capture the game's atmosphere.  
 Translation improvements include Japanese, German, Brazilian Portuguese, Simplified Chinese, Bengali, Basque, and many others.  
[/olist]  

Audio Enhancements – A New Horror Experience  
New character sounds  
New sound effects for the protagonist have been added—from breathing to fear reactions—making every moment of tension even more immersive.  

Reworked pain sounds  
The old pain sound has been replaced with a new recording that better conveys the character’s emotions, making every moment of suffering feel more realistic.  

Other Changes & Fixes  
[olist]  
 Additional improvements for smoother and more stable gameplay.  
 UI elements refined for better readability.  
 Minor bugs removed to improve the overall experience.  
[/olist]  

A big thank you to all players for your feedback, bug reports, and support. Thanks to you, HorrorCore is getting even better. Explore carefully and don’t trust what you see...

notes.title: Big Update: Monster Improvements, Navigation, Flash Flicker Tweaks & More
notes.content:
Hello!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45416851/e455230bea9cec9a7444d8f33e3b2b4a13b01066.gif

A new update is available! To download it, please restart your Steam client. As a solo developer, I need a bit more time for updates. Thanks for your suggestions and feedback—I’ve implemented things you mentioned on the forum, in videos, or via private messages.

Gameplay and Horror Improvements
[olist]
Increased probability of monster attacks in "Normal Game" mode – To increase the difficulty level, the probability of monster attacks has been raised on specific levels. This change makes the game more intense and engaging, requiring more attention and preparation. The "Adventure" mode (no monsters) and "HorrorCore" mode (the highest number of monsters) remain unchanged, allowing players to choose their preferred challenge level.

Added new navigation hints – Additional bloody arrows have been added that appear when an area is illuminated, indicating the correct path. Additionally, some areas now have more light, significantly improving navigation in dark locations and enhancing the overall gameplay experience, especially in more complex levels.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45416851/538e264b4ba66a7654d54b4d3f92b6886f0fbd79.png

Improved "Disable Flash Flicker" option – Optimized how this feature works. When flickering is turned off, the flash now stays on briefly and fades out slowly, giving the player extra time to look around. This subtle change enhances immersion by eliminating distracting flickering that could divert attention at crucial moments.

Flash flicker disabled:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45416851/52dfa4c30dafbc6879a99e30bff4516a8d580b48.gif

Extended default flash duration – The default flash duration has been increased from 0.3s to 1s, allowing players to explore locations without feeling rushed. This also provides a better opportunity to notice details and hidden elements in the environment.

Default option:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45416851/ed11d06ea9e86a590aed8d196165cf2757682298.gif

Added option to disable voice-over dialogues – More flexibility has been introduced in the audio settings, allowing players to choose between disabling only voices or muting dialogues entirely. This feature gives greater control over how players experience the story and the extent to which they immerse themselves in narrative audio elements.

Reduced volume of certain sound effects by 30% – Adjusted the volume of sound effects to avoid excessive loudness, which could interfere with other audio elements like music or dialogue. This change aims to create a more balanced sound environment.

Added shutter sound volume control – A new option has been introduced, allowing players to lower or increase the volume of the shutter sound, enabling a customized experience based on personal preferences.

Lower shutter volume:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45416851/f4c02605d7f729044575a379aee6177a11ebd287.png
[/olist]

Optimization and Performance
[olist]
Increased FPS and performance improvements – Several optimizations have been made to improve game performance. These adjustments have increased the frame rate (FPS) by 5%-25%, ensuring smoother gameplay and minimizing lag, especially on lower-end PCs.

Reduced RAM usage – Thanks to optimizations, the game now uses less RAM, improving stability, especially during longer play sessions when system resources may be heavily utilized.
[/olist]

Technical Updates
[olist]
Support for new platforms – The game has been updated to support Windows 64-bit, Windows 32-bit, Mac 64-bit (Intel64 + Apple Silicon), and Linux 64-bit. This makes the game accessible to a broader audience, regardless of their operating system.

Fixes for levels 2 and 3 – Various fixes have been implemented for levels 2 and 3, improving both gameplay and visual quality. Players will notice improved navigation and better-balanced challenges on these levels.

Minor gamepad improvements – Enhanced support for gamepads, eliminating small bugs that could occur when playing with a controller. The game now runs more smoothly on all compatible controllers.

Minor graphical improvements – Small adjustments have been made to some graphical elements, improving the visual quality of the game, especially on older devices.

Minor animation improvements – Small refinements have been made to monster animations to make their movements smoother, such as on level 2.
[/olist]

Other
[olist]
 Demo is ready and awaiting Valve approval – The game demo has been completed and is awaiting approval from Valve, allowing a wider audience to experience the game before its full release.

 Various small fixes – A range of minor fixes has been made to enhance the overall gameplay experience, making it more stable and player-friendly.
[/olist]

More updates will be coming soon! Let me know on the forum if you’re missing any features. For example, I could add an option for the camera to function as a flashlight.

notes.title: HorrorCore - First Update is Here
notes.content:
Version 1.1.5v is now live. This update brings important fixes and improvements based on your feedback. More updates are coming soon.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45416851/993133c547f87213048ab48b1686bcbb66ce64ad.gif

🔧 Patch Notes:

[olist]
Fixed achievements ("Forgotten Halls" and some post-game issues)
Fixed achievement issues – resolved problems with achievements in the "Forgotten Halls" chapter and other post-game progression issues. Now, players can fully enjoy the achievement system, with achievements being correctly awarded upon meeting the required conditions.

Fixed sound for autosave trigger
Fixed the sound issue triggered by the autosave system. The autosave sound is now properly synchronized with the save moment, improving the audio experience during gameplay.

Adjustments to The Void Between (Level 3)
Several fixes and adjustments have been made to the third level, "The Void Between." Changes include gameplay balance improvements and minor tweaks aimed at enhancing immersion and providing a smoother experience on this level.

Fixes for Endless Hallways (Level 1) (hidden text)
Fixes have been applied to the "Endless Hallways" (Level 1), including the correction of hidden text that may have previously been undetectable to players. These changes improve the clarity of the story and make hidden narrative elements more accessible.

Localization improvements, including Korean fixes (1.0.4v)
Localization improvements have been made, including fixes for the Korean version. These updates involve correcting translations and improving the quality of text to ensure a better experience for players in Korea.

Light issue fixed on Level 5 (1.0.3v)
A lighting issue on Level 5 has been resolved, which was affecting visibility in certain areas. Thanks to the fixes, the lighting now works as intended, enhancing atmosphere and visibility throughout the game.

Updated versions for Windows (64/32-bit), Linux (64-bit), Mac (Intel 64bit + Apple Silicon)
Updated versions for Windows (64/32-bit), Linux (64-bit), and Mac (Intel 64bit + Apple Silicon) have been released. These updates improve compatibility, performance, and stability across various platforms.

Demo preparation underway! (ETA: 1-7 days)
Demo preparation is underway, with an expected availability within 1-7 days. Players will soon be able to try out the game before its full release.

Various small fixes
Various small fixes have been implemented, covering different aspects of the game – from performance optimizations to bug fixes and quality-of-life improvements. These changes aim to further enhance the overall player experience.
[/olist]

🔜 Next updates

Here's a sneak peek at what's coming soon (I need some time to test it):
